product.title: CDPSR59 Wifi Smart RGBCW 3W Stainless Steel Directional Pathway Light LED Bollard Landscape Lighting
product.body_html:
Installation Tutorial Video

CDPSR59 3W AC/DC Philips LED bollard path light is a high-class pathway light that can definitely be your best option to install outside your home and also other places that match the light’s decoration. While providing low voltage energy-efficient LED, this will consume less power and will decrease your electricity replacing the Halogen 20W bulbs with this 3W directional LED bollard pathway lights wired because the Halogen 20W bulbs consume much more power while both emit the same capacity of light. It has RGBCW Color Changing LED that connects with its App so it can be controlled through your phone for ease of mind. The light body is made up of Heavy Duty Stainless Steel with Black coating finishing.

The rectangular head of the light is of 5.5” (L) x 2” (W) as dimension and the height of the body is 21.5”. This light provides 270 Lumens and comes up with a lifespan of 60,000 hours which gives a more lasting life span than other sellers. A ground ABS spike is included to stake into the ground. IP65 is the quality that indicates a waterproof feature provided with this Path Light.

Important:

Before installing the fixture, please download the app to your mobile device and pair the fixture first. Ensure that pairing is successfully completed prior to installation at your desired location. If the fixture is not detected during setup, move it closer to your Wi-Fi router to establish a proper connection. When connecting multiple fixtures, pair them one by one so you can rename each fixture individually to avoid confusion during operation and control.

All low voltage outdoor lights must be installed with a 12V Low Voltage Transformer and connections between lights must be secured using Grease Filled Wire Nuts (WN12) waterproof connectors.
